_comment: Curated public datasets. Only facts confirmed from the repository page or paper go in; anything unconfirmed says so in `status`/`notes`. `use` says which site tab the dataset feeds; `pipeline` points at the scripts that download and convert it.

datasets.paper: Chiffelle et al., Immunity 2024 — Tumor-reactive T cell clonotype dynamics underlying clinical response to TIL therapy in melanoma
datasets.samples: 13 patients (6 responders, 7 non-responders); scRNA-seq of 15 baseline tumors, 13 TIL products, 7 post-ACT tumors; bulk TCR-seq of blood before and 30 days after
datasets.status: Accession from the preprint's data statement (to be released at publication); confirm it is public

datasets.paper: Barras et al., Sci Immunol 2024 — Response to TIL adoptive therapy is associated with preexisting CD8+ T-myeloid cell networks in melanoma
datasets.samples: 13 patients, longitudinal pre- and post-ACT tumors
datasets.status: GEO series confirmed; the multiplex IF images are not confirmed public

datasets.paper: Huang et al., J Clin Invest 2022 — Phase I study of adjuvant immunotherapy with autologous TILs in locally advanced cervical cancer
datasets.samples: 13 patients infused; scRNA-seq of 8 TIL infusion products
datasets.status: Accessions from the paper's data statement; GEO page not checked (NCBI browser check)

datasets.paper: Sade-Feldman et al., Cell 2018 — Defining T cell states associated with response to checkpoint immunotherapy in melanoma
datasets.samples: 16,291 CD45+ immune cells from 48 tumor samples, pre- and on-treatment
datasets.status: Public since Oct 2018; files: TPM matrix (121 MB) and per-cell patient/response table

datasets.paper: Pozniak et al., Cell 2024 — melanoma single-cell atlas during immunotherapy
datasets.samples: Count matrices for malignant and microenvironment cells; clinical metadata in the paper's Table S1
datasets.status: Open; Visium deposit holds images only, not spot counts

datasets.paper: Krishna et al., Science 2020 — Stem-like CD8 T cells mediate response of adoptive cell immunotherapy against human cancer
datasets.samples: 18,624 CD8+ TILs from 10 infusion products (scRNA-seq); flow on products from a larger cohort
datasets.status: Data accession not confirmed; check the paper's data availability statement

datasets.paper: 10x Genomics public dataset — Xenium Prime FFPE human skin (primary dermal melanoma)
datasets.samples: 1 section, 112,551 cells; two smaller Xenium v1 melanoma sections also public

accessions.label: Zenodo 17429142 (all three sections, 114 GB with images)

datasets.paper: Multiplexed imaging mass cytometry reveals distinct tumor-immune microenvironments linked to immunotherapy responses in melanoma (bioRxiv 2022.01.15.476480; PMC9587266)
datasets.samples: 26 patients on anti-PD-1 monotherapy (14 responders, 12 non-responders)

accessions.label: Zenodo 6838169 (3.6 GB: images, masks, processed data, clinical response)

datasets.status: Open; response and survival tables included

datasets.paper: Lee et al. — Single-cell spatial transcriptomics uncovers niches that govern response to PD-1/PD-L1 blockade in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
datasets.samples: 27 patients from two phase II trials, >250,000 cells, before/during/after treatment; response by major pathological response
datasets.status: Open; whether response labels are inside the Seurat object is unconfirmed

datasets.paper: Integrated single-cell and spatial analysis reveals context-dependent myeloid-T cell interactions in the response to immune checkpoint blockade in HNSCC
datasets.status: Open; the Visium part of the study is not in this deposit

datasets.paper: Immunologic determinants of infusion products and the tumor microenvironment govern response to TIL therapy in advanced melanoma (Med)
datasets.samples: 60 patients enrolled 2009–2018; tumor, immune and TLS regions
datasets.status: Data availability not confirmed — the closest TIL-specific spatial dataset if released
